name: AnchorBadge – Sticky Floating Badges & Announcements
author: kostasthanos

sections.description:
AnchorBadge lets you place a fixed floating element in any corner of your site — always visible as visitors scroll.

Choose between two modes:

Image Badge — upload any image (JPG, PNG, WebP) and pin it to a corner with a link. Perfect for logos, certification badges, trust marks, banners and award logos.

Announcement — display a short text message with an optional button. Ideal for promotions, notices, and calls to action.

Free Features

  • Two modes: Image Badge and Announcement
  • Image upload — JPG, PNG, WebP up to 10 MB
  • Image fit: contain, cover, fill — with focus point for cover
  • Optional background color with opacity
  • 4 corner positions — always fixed, always visible
  • Custom margins, desktop and mobile sizing, border radius, padding
  • External, internal, or media file link support (image mode)
  • Announcement text with font family, size, and color options
  • One button per announcement with label, URL, and color
  • 5 close button icon styles with color picker
  • Cookie or session close behavior
  • Show on entire site, front page, or a specific page/post
  • Live admin preview
  • Clean, lightweight output — no jQuery on the frontend
  • Secure — nonces, capability checks, MIME validation

Privacy

AnchorBadge does not collect or transmit any personal data. The optional close cookie stores only a “1” value locally in the visitor’s browser.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the anchorbadge folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through Plugins > Installed Plugins
  3. Go to AnchorBadge in your WordPress admin menu
  4. Choose your mode, configure your settings, enable, and save
sections.faq:
What image formats are supported?

JPG, PNG, WebP, and GIF — up to 10 MB.

Can I show the badge only on certain pages?

Yes — entire site, front page only, or one specific page or post.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes. The close cookie stores only a “1” value. No data is sent to any external server.

Does it work with caching plugins?

Yes. Badge rendering is server-side and the JS works with any caching setup.
